description: Golden reference for FEM A-V (gapped torus, source/sink, MCP-documented formulation).
rationale: Locks: (1) A-V compound FES with phi Dirichlet-lift on source/sink ports; (2) volume-integral current extraction int J.grad(psi_n) dV (MCP ih_knowledge AV_COIL_SIGMA); (3) wp SIBC Robin. P_wp matches 2D axisym SIBC reference to <2% (primary metric for IH heating analysis). L and P_coil are mesh-sensitive when coil h > delta/3 and relax loosely.

sample.mesh_note: Gapped torus (5 deg) with source/sink port sidesets, wp cylinder hole (sibc sideset), Kelvin exterior with periodic identification. Coil surface mesh ~0.16mm (delta/5 at Cu 7kHz); interior ~0.5mm (delta/1.6 — still under-resolved for |J|^2 convergence).

physics.coil: gapped torus R=30mm a=3mm gap=5deg, Cu sigma=5.8e7
physics.workpiece: cylinder R=25mm H=25mm as hole in air, Cu sigma=5.8e7, mu_r=1

reference_2d_axisym_sibc.note: 2D axisym, sigma_coil=0 (uniform J), wp full-eddy resolved. Matches PEEC+BEM and FEM A-V wp heating within 2%.

reference_2d_axisym_full_eddy.note: 2D axisym, sigma_coil=5.8e7, both coil + wp full-eddy. P_coil_implied ~ 8.4e-5.

expected.note_Pcoil: P_coil is volumetric |J|^2/sigma; mesh-sensitive. On the ih_fem_kelvin_skin_fine sample it is ~75% above the 2D axisym full-eddy implied value; treat as upper bound.  For an exact thin-wire estimate use Dowell analytical in examples/ (panel-demoted 2026-04-19).

source_of_truth: A-V formulation per MCP ih_knowledge INDUCTION_HEATING_AV_COIL_SIGMA; volumetric |J|^2/sigma P_coil (mesh-sensitive, accepted as engineering approximation).
